about: Rankings: HLTV's Top 20 Players of the Year (2011, 2013-2015) and Esports Earnings' 2012 CS:GO prize money. Configs come from public archives of pro CS:GO configs (mostly game-written config.cfg files in setup.gg's GitHub archive) and Liquipedia's settings tables. A date comes from the settings a file contains (checked against Valve's release notes), from a date written in the file or on its source (a header comment, Liquipedia's "Updated as of"), or else from the archive's commit date as an upper bound; each page lists its sources and how each date is known.

years.note: A CS 1.6 ranking (CS:GO came out in August 2012), so these are the players' CS:GO configs from later, each labelled with its date.
